OrderConfirmation.Subject: Order Confirmation - Your AlliEats Order #{orderNumber}

OrderStatusUpdate.Subject: Order Update - Order #{orderNumber}

OrderReady.Subject: Order Ready - Order #{orderNumber}
OrderReady.Body:
Dear {customerName},

Great news! Your order is ready!

Order Number: #{orderNumber}
Status: Ready for Delivery

Your delicious food is prepared and ready. Our delivery partner will pick it up shortly and deliver it to you.

Estimated delivery time: 15-30 minutes

Thank you for choosing AlliEats!

OrderDelivered.Subject: Order Out for Delivery - Order #{orderNumber}
OrderDelivered.Body:
Dear {customerName},

Your order is now out for delivery!

Order Number: #{orderNumber}
Status: On the Way

Please confirm that you have received your order within the next 2 hours. If you don't confirm receipt within this time, the order will be automatically marked as received.

We hope you enjoy your meal! Don't forget to leave a review.

Thank you for choosing AlliEats!

OrderCancelled.Subject: Order Cancelled - Order #{orderNumber}
OrderCancelled.Body:
Dear {customerName},

We regret to inform you that your order has been cancelled.

Order Number: #{orderNumber}
Status: Cancelled
Reason: {reason}

If you have any questions or concerns about this cancellation, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support.

We apologize for any inconvenience and look forward to serving you again soon.

Thank you for choosing AlliEats!
